items.text: YOU FIND A PILE OF MINE TAILINGS. IN IT IS A KOBOLD'S CRUDE DRAWING. YOU RECORD IT IN YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY 42.
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE KOBOLD RETREATS, THEN STRIKES THE WALL.
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: THE KOBOLD CRIES OUT, 'I'LL NOT GO ALONE!'
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: THE ROOF COLLAPSES. BEFORE YOU RECOVER, KOBOLDS ARRIVE.
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: AS YOU PULL, THE STOPPER COMES LOOSE AND SMOKE BILLOWS OUT, FORMING INTO A GIANT, REDDISH HUMANOID. 'I AM THE EFREETI SAMIR AHWAHL. YOU ARE NOT MY MASTER. ARE YOU, PERCHANCE, VAMPIRES?'
items.direction: perform Samir Ahwahl consistently as a proud, powerful efreeti with fiery authority; retain narrator identity for attribution

items.text: YOU HEAR MUFFLED SOUNDS AND TURN TO INVESTIGATE. IN THIS ROOM IS A YOUNG WOMAN IN BARBARIAN FINERY. SHE DROPS A KOBOLD SHE WAS STRANGLING WHEN SHE SEES YOU. 'I AM PRINCESS FATIMA.' THE PRINCESS CONTINUES. YOU RECORD IT IN YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY 16. SHE OFFERS TO JOIN YOUR BAND.
items.direction: perform Princess Fatima consistently as a fierce, confident young barbarian noblewoman; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: WHEN YOU GIVE IT WATER, IT CRAWLS OUT AND TELLS YOU ITS TALE. YOU RECORD IT IN YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY 20. AFTER IT IS DONE, IT LEAVES.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE KOBOLD PAUSES, IDLY TAPS THE WALL, THEN PROCEEDS. A BOULDER BLOCKS OFF THE PASSAGE. USING A LEVER, THE KOBOLD DISLODGES IT AND PROCEEDS. DO YOU?
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: THE KOBOLD DISAPPEARS BEYOND THE BOULDER. YOU CLAMBER NOISILY DOWN A SLOPE OF RUBBLE. AT THE BOTTOM THE KOBOLD DIVES BENEATH SOME RUBBLE. 'JUST AROUND THE CORNER IS OUR TREASURE. TAKE WHAT YOU WISH AND LEAVE US. GOOD DAY.'
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: KOBOLDS APPEAR AND BOMBARD YOU WITH ROCKS.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: WHAT DO YOU DO?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: DO YOU WANT TO LEAVE?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE PRINCESS SAYS,'I SHALL GO MY OWN WAY NOW, BUT YOU WILL ALWAYS BE REMEMBERED. GOOD HUNTING.'
items.direction: perform Princess Fatima consistently as a fierce, confident young barbarian noblewoman; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: YOU CROSS OVER A PIT.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A KOBOLD APPROACHES WAVING A WHITE FLAG.
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: THE KOBOLD BOWS AND SAYS,'YOU ARE QUITE DANGEROUS, WE WILL PAY FOR A TRUCE.'
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: 'I AM TO ESCORT YOU TO OUR TREASURE.'
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: YOU DISARM A DEADFALL TRAP.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: TIMBERS LINE THE WALLS HERE. A BOULDER BLOCKS THE FAR END.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A NET ENTANGLES YOU.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU DISARM A NET TRAP.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: SPIKES SPRING OUT AND IMPALE YOU.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU DISARM A SPIKE TRAP.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A DRUNKEN KOBOLD LIES HERE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU SLIP BY WITH EASE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: HE LOOKS CONFUSED,'OH, THE ENVOYS. DO YOU WISH AN ESCORT TO THE KING?'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: 'THEN FOLLOW ME.'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE KOBOLD PROMPTLY RETURNS TO SLEEP.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE KOBOLD DIES.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU HEAR THE VOICES OF HUMANS AND KOBOLDS.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: BEFORE YOU IS A HORDE OF KOBOLDS. BEHIND THEM ARE TWO MEN AND AN ANCIENT KOBOLD ON A WOODEN THRONE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: ONE SAYS,'THESE MEN ARE ENEMIES. DEFEAT THEM AND MY LORD SHALL BE MOST GENEROUS.' THE KING LOOKS AT HIM, AND THEN AT YOU. HE SMILES AND SCREAMS, 'KILL THEM!'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE KING, FROTHING AT THE MOUTH, CRIES, 'USE THE SECRET WEAPONS.' BALLISTA APPEAR AND FIRE.
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE MEN SNEER AT THE KING AND ONE SAYS,'LET US SHOW YOU HOW WARRIORS FIGHT.'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE TWO ENVOYS WAIT AT THE THRONE. THEY SMILE. 'A REMATCH THEN. PREPARE FOR DEATH.'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE KING HAS ESCAPED DURING THE FIGHT.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: KOBOLDS BLOCK ALL THE EXITS.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE KING CALLS OUT,'YOU SEEM VALUABLE. SURRENDER OR DIE.'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE BALLISTA ARE RELOADED. THE KING CALLS OUT,'DEATH OR IMPRISONMENT.'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: YOU FIND A SECRET DOOR IN THE NORTH WALL.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU REACH THE KING'S QUARTERS AND CONFRONT HIS GUARDS.
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE KING, PANICKED, HAS FALLEN INTO HIS OWN SPIKED PIT AND DIED.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU SEE A BRASS BOTTLE JAMMED INTO A CRACK HERE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'FOOLS, SUMMON ME ONLY WHEN A VAMPIRE IS NEAR OR FACE MY WRATH.' HE RETURNS TO THE BOTTLE.
items.direction: perform Samir Ahwahl consistently as a proud, powerful efreeti with fiery authority; retain narrator identity for attribution

items.text: 'DIE HAPPY FIENDS, YOUR DEATHS SHALL BE MY FREEDOM.'
items.direction: perform Samir Ahwahl consistently as a proud, powerful efreeti with fiery authority; retain narrator identity for attribution

items.text: YOU ARE IN A CRUDE BARRACKS. ON ONE WALL IS A CRUDE MAP.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU RECORD IT IN YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY 28.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'YOUR GROUP IS TOO LARGE.'
items.direction: perform Princess Fatima consistently as a fierce, confident young barbarian noblewoman; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: SHE SMILES.'SO I SHALL CUT MY OWN WAY OUT. GOOD HUNTING.' SHE LEAVES.
items.direction: perform Princess Fatima consistently as a fierce, confident young barbarian noblewoman; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: THIS WAS A PRISON CELL. BROKEN BINDINGS AND SIX DEAD KOBOLDS ARE STREWN ON THE FLOOR.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU TUMBLE DOWN A STEEP, LOOSE SLOPE, MAKING A LOUD CLATTER.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THERE IS A STEEP RUBBLED SLOPE. WILL YOU GO UP?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU DISLODGE A NUMBER OF ROCKS.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE NOISE HAS DISTURBED SOMETHING. WITH A BEATING OF WINGS, A HUGE BEAST LANDS UPON YOU.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: BEFORE YOU LIES A HUGE WYVERN. IT RISES UP AND CHARGES.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: HIDDEN IN A NARROW CREVICE IS AN OLD CRIPPLED KOBOLD. IT CROAKS WEAKLY FOR WATER.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE KOBOLD RETREATS AROUND A BEND.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU CUT DOWN THE KOBOLD.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THIS IS THE LIVING AREAS. FEMALE AND CHILD KOBOLDS FLEE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: RATS ARE HUNG HERE TO AGE. MOLDY ROOTS LIE IN PILES.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: HERE CRUDE TABLES, LITTERED WITH BONES, ARE SCATTERED AROUND.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A RUINED BALLISTA LIES HERE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AMONGST A NEST OF LOGS YOU FIND SOME TREASURE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: STREWN ACROSS THE FLOOR IS THE ACCUMULATED WEALTH OF THE KOBOLD COMMUNITY.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND A TRAP, BUT THE TUNNEL IS TOO NARROW TO AVOID IT.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE KOBOLD CALLS OUT,'THE ENVOYS ARE HERE, GREAT KING.' AN AGED VOICE REPLIES 'SEND THEM FORWARD.' YOUR GUIDE, HOWEVER, HAS FALLEN INTO A STUPOR.
items.direction: perform the kobold guide consistently as nervous, deferential, and cunning; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: THE KOBOLDS HERD YOU TOWARD YOUR PRISON. SOME NAB BITS OF YOUR EQUIPMENT AND LEAVE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A WOMAN APPEARS BEFORE YOU.'I AM THE PRINCESS FATIMA, AID ME IN THIS BATTLE.'
items.direction: perform Princess Fatima consistently as a fierce, confident young barbarian noblewoman; retain narrator identity for narration

items.text: THE KOBOLDS CHASE FOR A WHILE, BUT YOU ESCAPE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: KOBOLDS SEEM TO BOIL UP FROM NOWHERE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ARE THROWN INTO A CELL BEREFT OF EQUIPMENT.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene
